compute_text_duplicates: compute the duplicate fraction of strings in a list using the TextDuplicates measurement
list_text_duplicates: list duplicate strings and their counts from a dataset with the TextDuplicates measurement
get_string_hash: get the MD5 hash of a stripped UTF-8 encoded string
get_text_duplicates_info: get the measurement info including features and description for TextDuplicates
load_text_duplicates: load the text_duplicates measurement from the HuggingFace evaluate library
